players.name: Raleigh/Jeffers
players.summary: Ryan Jeffers fractured his hamate bone and had surgery; expected to miss 6-8 weeks with an early July return target. Twins selected journeyman Alex Jackson to take his roster spot.

sources.title: Ryan Jeffers Diagnosed With Hamate Fracture — MLB Trade Rumors

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Went 0-for-4 in Phillies' 4-2 loss at Dodger Stadium as Wrobleski dominated through 7 innings. All 4 Dodgers runs came on solo HRs from Freeman, Muncy, Ohtani, and Will Smith.

sources.title: Justin Wrobleski's Dominant Start Beats Zack Wheeler and Phils — Dodgers Beat

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Picked up a single at Coors Field but Giants fell 8-6 to Colorado. Season batting average holds at .319 — still among MLB's best contact hitters.

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Singled and scored in the Mets' wild 9-7 comeback win over Miami in 10 innings. MJ Melendez hit the walk-off 2-run homer after NYM had squandered a 4-run lead.

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Kevin McGonigle went 1-for-4 with a single as Detroit fell 4-3 to the White Sox in 10 innings on a walk-off homer by Manny Vargas.

sources.title: Detroit Tigers vs. Chicago White Sox — CBS Sports

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: Hit a double in the 9th and scored in a losing effort as the Cubs dropped a 6-5 decision in St. Louis. Imanaga took the loss; Riley O'Brien earned the save for the Cardinals.

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill's first homer since May 4 — a 2-run blast off Mitchell Parker in the 7th — gave the Padres a 7-5 win over Washington, snapping a 4-game losing streak.

sources.title: Merrill 2-run HR in 7th gives Padres 7-5 win over Nationals — Washington Post

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Placed on the 10-day IL with a Grade 1 left hamstring strain suffered May 28 while running to first vs Colorado. Dave Roberts expects a 1-3 week absence; Ryan Ward recalled.

sources.title: Dodgers Move Teoscar Hernandez to IL — Dodger Nation

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: Ben Rice drove in a run in the Yankees' 8-2 rout of Oakland. New York's offense was powered by Goldschmidt (3 RBI) and Judge (2 RBI).

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Pitched a scoreless inning (3 K, 3 BB) but didn't earn a save as the Mets blew a 4-run lead before winning 9-7 over Miami in 10 innings on Melendez's walk-off shot.

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Surrendered 4 solo home runs over 6 innings to Freeman, Muncy, Ohtani, and Will Smith — only the 2nd time in his career allowing 4 HRs in a start. PHI fell 4-2 in the series opener at LAD.

sources.title: Long ball bites Wheeler in Dodgers series opener — Phillies Nation

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Suffered a setback during his rehab outing — reported similar pain to his original elbow impingement. Shut down from throwing again; return timeline now uncertain.

sources.title: Cole Ragans Pauses Rehab After Elbow Stiffness — MLB Trade Rumors

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Off day between starts after winning his 5th on May 27. Paddack started for Cincinnati vs Atlanta; Braves won 8-3. Burns' next start expected over the weekend.

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Did not start Friday's game vs Kansas City — MacKenzie Gore took the ball and dealt 6.1 shutout IP in a 9-1 Rangers win. Eovaldi's status for his next turn in the rotation is unclear.

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Not scheduled to start Friday as Wrobleski opened the Phillies series for the Dodgers. Sheehan remains healthy and in the rotation; next start expected over the weekend.

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Dominant 6-inning, 8-K performance (90 pitches) earned the win in Angels' 5-4 road victory at Tampa Bay. Following his career-high 14-K outing May 24, Detmers looks to be turning a corner.

sources.title: Reid Detmers against the Rays — MLB.com

injuries.name: Raleigh/Jeffers
injuries.note: Fractured hamate bone, surgery performed ~May 20. Expected return early July at the earliest.
